version.changelog:
- Project terminology updated from "CDK" to "project" throughout docs and install steps
- Install and deployment commands revised to use `cargo-ai project` instead of `cargo-ai cdk`
- References to "CDK project" replaced with "project (the folder holding cargo.json)"
- Outdated technical references and instructions corrected to match new toolchain flows
- Obsolete file `skill-card.md` removed for clarity and maintenance

llm.summary: The skill’s inbound-lead workflow is coherent, but it needs review because public form text is posted into an internal Slack channel as markdown without sanitization.

dimensions.detail: Visitor-controlled names, message text, and page URL are interpolated directly into Slack markdown with no escaping or length limits, creating a public-form-to-internal-Slack content injection risk.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses the Cargo CLI and project add flow, with deployment gated on an explicit yes; no hidden local hooks, remote payload execution, or secret-writing install step was found.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The instructions are mostly scoped and require planning plus explicit approval before deploy; broad trigger phrases are tempered by skip guidance and the workflow remains tied to inbound demo forms.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Deployment creates persistent Cargo workspace resources and shared model columns as expected; the research play is shipped disabled, limited to qualified contacts, and uses read-only context plus web search when enabled.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches the artifacts: collect website demo requests, enrich the company by work email, write shared GTM account/contact rows, post to Slack, and optionally research qualified contacts later.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review before installing or deploying. Keep the explicit deploy approval, origin allowlist, and privacy-page requirement, and fix the Slack message path by escaping or rendering visitor-provided values as plain text with server-side length limits.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced artifacts were present in the workspace and inspected; the partial-inspection concern is not supported after review.
[P9] expected: The detected long spaces are markdown table alignment in SKILL.md, not hidden off-screen instructions.
[SQP-1] expected: Some trigger phrases are broad, but the skill also provides skip cases and the implemented behavior stays within the inbound website demo-request workflow.
[SQP-2] expected: Personal data collection, company enrichment, Slack posting, and model storage are core disclosed behaviors; the artifacts require a reviewed privacy page, though the sample form itself should link or show that notice.
[T09] unexpected: The static finding is supported by artifact code: untrusted form fields are inserted into a Slack markdown message without output encoding or size limits. This appears to be a coding flaw, not intentional abuse.
